label: context.reference
text:
Use the Atlassian Rovo Application through world_mcp_atlassian_rovo. Project EE policy must admit it, and the task needs its exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Installation and connection do not establish server liveness.

Use the server's catalogs for Atlassian search, Jira, Confluence, and other Rovo capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Current capabilities are declared in mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog from world_mcp_atlassian_rovo.

Invoke a tool with artifact.send to world_mcp_atlassian_rovo, label mcp.operation.request, operation atlassian_rovo.call_tool, and arguments containing the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use atlassian_rovo.read_resource, atlassian_rovo.get_prompt and atlassian_rovo.complete with catalog identifiers; use atlassian_rovo.status or atlassian_rovo.ping to check liveness or negotiated capabilities.

Wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event or refusal artifact before reporting an effect. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens and refresh state stay private to the interface; transfer only non-secret handles and status artifacts.
